name: SOURCE_FILING_KEY_STABLE
findings: nreg (IPP) and registro oficial (ESEF) are stable, unique, official registration keys.
Each period maps to one nreg (IPP) / one registro oficial (ESEF) within the corpus; keys are unique + stable across repeated observations.
A substitution/revision is NOT observed in the corpus (all SAN/BBVA/IBE rows are clean initial submissions; col 4 Ampliación información empty).

Source legend: col (1) 'Fecha de publicación' = date of initial submission OR date of the LAST substitution to the initial submission; col (4) covers 'modificación de ficheros sin reformulación, corrigiendo el etiquetado'.

Best observed: nreg/registro = logical filing (source_registration_no, unique + stable across observations); ?e= token = per-version artefact locator; ?t={GUID} = ephemeral transport (never identity).
Stability across a REAL substitution = NOT_YET_PROVEN (inferred from legend, not observed) -> deferred to R13; must not be inherited as fact by R13.
Model implication: filing = nreg/registro; filing_version = ?e= token + fecha de publicación.
limitations: Substitution semantics are taken from the source legend plus the absence of an in-corpus substitution; no directly-observed substitution was available to falsify against. Re-test if a real substitution appears in the corpus.
